release_notes: Admin account management overhaul: /admin/account/show now aggregates all real services (hosting package, radio streaming stations, chatbox tenant, game servers, billing products) with manage links; account delete now actually removes the hosting_users row + billing cascade; delete button added to account list; billing products page shows people/orders/services counts per product (parsed from items JSON); package edit page redesigned into the admin layout. Also: admin redesign (stat cards/grouped tables), chat dashboard in-panel manage, phpMyAdmin/webmail fixes, updater hardening (sudoers idempotent, patch repair).
